title: Relation file
description: One file per relation family under data/relations/. Each file is a flat array of relations. `certainty` is a first-class feature, not metadata: the sources contradict each other constantly, and surfacing that disagreement is one of the most interesting things this project can do.

id.description: Exactly `<from>--<to>--<type>`. Deterministic and derivable; the validator recomputes it and rejects any mismatch.

type.description: Each type belongs to exactly one family, and the validator enforces that a type only appears in its own file.

directed.description: False for symmetric relations (married_to, sibling_of, blood_brother_of). The renderer draws an arrowhead only when true.

certainty.description: attested — the source states it outright. implied — the source entails it without stating it. variant — another source gives a different account of the same event. disputed — the sources actively contradict each other. unverified — believed true, no locus confirmed; sources MUST be empty and the relation MUST be listed in data/TODO.md.

work.description: An id from data/sources.json. Individual works, not collections: `gylfaginning`, not `prose-edda`.

locus.description: Chapter or stanza within the work, per that work's `locusUnit`. A bare number, or a range like `34-35`.

contradicts.description: Optional. Relation ids giving a competing account of the same event. Populated on `variant` and `disputed` relations so the interface can offer the reader a toggle between readings instead of silently picking a winner.

allOf.description: No relation may have an empty sources array unless certainty is `unverified` — and conversely, a relation with a real locus is by definition not unverified.
Symmetric relation types must not be marked directed.
